summary: First-run E2E testing of GezGelir driver app. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed against public URL (health, config, driver/me, trips + range monotonicity + 404, earnings/summary for today|week|month|total, earnings/series week returns 7 buckets with 200 (previous 500 bug is fixed), wallet, wallet/transactions with signed amounts, withdraw overdraw -> 400, withdraw success reduces available and creates negative İşleniyor tx, drive/stop creates trip with eligible ≈ 0.97*distance, earning = eligible*rate, status İşleniyor, increases pending, adds earning tx). Frontend (mobile 390x844): splash -> 3-step onboarding completes, all 5 bottom-nav tabs render and navigate, Home shows Ömer greeting + BUGÜNKÜ KAZANCIN hero + ₺ + Sürüşe Başla + recent-trip. Drive session -> finish -> drive-result overlay with ₺ amount -> Harika! returns Home. Sürüşler shows range tabs today/week/month, 13 trip items, trip-detail-sheet opens and closes. Kazanç renders. Cüzdan withdraw sheet -> confirm -> withdraw-success shown, transaction items render. Profil shows Ömer Yılmaz / Volkswagen Passat / 34 GEZ 027 / Uygun and profile-sheet opens on menu tap. Turkish characters render correctly, ₺ used everywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py withdraw endpoint uses non-atomic read-then-update on driver balance; two concurrent withdraw requests could race and overdraw. Consider a conditional $inc with a filter {available_balance: {$gte: amount}} and check modified_count.

seed() runs on every startup and reads config from Mongo but falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG if insert races; harmless now but worth guarding with a unique index on drivers.id/config.id to prevent duplicate seeds if multiple workers start.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed() auto-populated demo driver 'Ömer', 14 trips, and 6 transactions. Tests additionally created 1 drive/stop trip and 1 small ₺10 withdrawal against the demo driver.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 15 cases). BASE_URL comes from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Tests mutate demo driver state (withdraw ₺10 + drive/stop 12 km per run) so pending/available balances drift with each run — acceptable for this demo. Use ?skip=1 to bypass splash+onboarding for deep-screen tests; the real onboarding path (3x onboarding-next) was validated in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failures observed. Previously reported /api/earnings/series 500 (range shadowing builtin) is confirmed fixed via Query(alias='range') and now returns 7 daily buckets.
